title: BOOK
newBadgeLegend: NEW means this book was added to the list since you last checked.

connection.label: BOOK catalog
connection.okEmpty: Connected · the catalog is currently empty
connection.errorNetwork: Couldn't reach the server — check your connection
connection.neverLoaded: No catalog has been successfully loaded yet

ambiguousNotice_one: We've left one book out of this list for now, because it isn't clear which one it is. Everything else works as usual, and nothing on your pen has changed.
ambiguousNotice_other: We've left {{count}} books out of this list for now, because it isn't clear which ones they are. Everything else works as usual, and nothing on your pen has changed.
penRequiredForWrite: Connect a pen to see and manage its BOOK content.
insufficientSpace: Not enough free space to complete this.
downloadFailed: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.
metadataIncompleteNotice: This item's catalog information is incomplete, so it can't be installed yet.
targetChangedSinceBackup: This file changed on the pen right before it could be removed — nothing was deleted. Please try again.
stalePlan: The pen changed — please try again.
backupFailed: Could not back up the existing file, so nothing was changed.
unknownContentNotice: This file isn't recognized as catalog BOOK content and can't be changed here.
confirmAddTitle: Some selected items differ from the pen
addConflictsHint: These already exist on the pen with different content. Choose whether to replace each one (a backup is kept first) or leave it as is.

status.verifiedDiffers: Last verified: differs from official version
status.matchedHashUnknown: On pen — no official checksum to check against
status.awaitingCatalog: On pen — catalog not loaded yet
status.onPenSizeDiffers: On pen — size differs from official

statusHelp.present: The name matches an official book, but the App has not read the file to check its contents. Refreshing never reads files, so this is the normal state until you choose Verify this file.
statusHelp.verifying: The App is reading this file now and comparing it with the official version.
statusHelp.verifiedCurrent: You verified this file and its contents matched the official version exactly. Shown only while that check still applies to this pen and this file.
statusHelp.verifiedDiffers: You verified this file and its contents did not match the official version — it may be an older edition or a damaged copy. Add it again from the official list to replace it.
statusHelp.sizeDiffers: The file size already differs from the official version, so the contents cannot match. Knowing this needed no reading of the file.
statusHelp.matchedHashUnknown: The name matches an official book, but the catalog publishes no checksum for it, so there is nothing to compare against.
statusHelp.awaitingCatalog: No catalog has been loaded yet, so this file has not been compared with anything. Connect to the internet and refresh.
statusHelp.unknown: This file is not in the official catalog. The App leaves it alone and will not remove or replace it.
statusHelp.notOnPen: This book is not on the connected pen.
statusHelp.onPenPresent: A file with this book's name is on the pen, but its contents have not been checked.
statusHelp.onPenVerifying: The App is reading the file on the pen now and comparing it with the official version.
statusHelp.onPenCurrent: The file on the pen was verified and matches this official version exactly.
statusHelp.onPenDiffers: The file on the pen was verified and does not match this official version. Add it to the pen to replace it — the existing file is backed up first.
statusHelp.onPenSizeDiffers: The file on the pen is a different size from this official version, so it cannot be the same content.
statusHelp.metadataIncomplete: The catalog entry is missing the file name or checksum the App needs, so this book cannot be installed yet. Nothing is wrong with your pen.
statusHelp.ambiguous: Two or more catalog entries claim the same file name, so the App cannot tell which one is meant. Shown for reference only until it is corrected on the server.

cacheHelp.cached: A checked copy is stored on this computer, so adding it to the pen needs no download.
cacheHelp.notDownloaded: Not stored on this computer yet. It is downloaded when you add it to the pen.
cacheHelp.downloading: Being downloaded to this computer now.

legend.title: What do these words mean?
legend.intro: Each book shows whether it is on your pen. Open Advanced details if you need the technical version.

simple.needsHelp: Something's not right — open for help

simpleHelp.onPen: This book is on your pen and ready to use.
simpleHelp.updateAvailable: A newer version of this book is available. Sync books replaces it — the old one is kept as a backup first.
simpleHelp.notOnPen: This book is not on your pen yet. Sync books puts it on.
simpleHelp.downloading: The book is being copied to this computer, and then to your pen.
simpleHelp.checking: The app is checking this book. It only takes a moment.
simpleHelp.needsHelp: This one needs a closer look — the book list may be incomplete. Nothing is wrong with your pen. Open Advanced details, or contact support.

advanced.title: Advanced details
advanced.hint: Technical information for support. You do not need this to use your pen.

catalogIntro: Bought a new book? Find it in this list and select Add.

done.restartBody: Please unplug your pen, then switch it off and on again. The first start may take a little longer while your pen gets its books ready.
done.updatedOnly: All done! Your book has been updated.

fix.title: Your pen's book list needs a moment
fix.body: Some books were added or removed outside this app, so your pen may play the wrong one. This takes a few seconds to put right.
fix.doneBody: All set. Please unplug your pen, then switch it off and on again. The first start may take a little longer.
fix.failed: That could not be finished just now. Nothing on your pen was changed — please reconnect it and try again.
fix.sidecarNotice: Some extra files copied by a Mac are also on your pen. They are harmless, but you can delete them from the pen folder if you like.

verifyHint: Open a book below to check it, if support asks you to.
booksManagedNotice: Books are looked after by the PonyABC library — you can add and update them here.

transfer.estimateBefore: This will take about {{minutes}} minutes. Please leave your pen plugged in.
transfer.estimateBeforeShort: This will take a minute or two. Please leave your pen plugged in.
transfer.dontUnplugBody: Your pen is being written to. Unplugging now could leave a book unfinished.

check.failed: We couldn't reach the PonyABC library. Check your internet connection and try again.

yourBooks.title: Your books
yourBooks.intro: The books on your pen right now.
yourBooks.empty: No books on your pen yet. Add some below.

otherBooks.title: Other books (not from PonyABC)
otherBooks.body: These came from somewhere else. This app leaves them exactly as they are.

newBooks.title: New books
newBooks.intro: Books you can add. Tick the ones whose cards you have.
newBooks.empty: Your pen already has every book we offer.
newBooks.badgeHint: NEW means this book was added to the list since you last checked.

footer.selectedShort: {{count}} book(s) selected, a minute or two
footer.none: Tick a book above to add it.

penRequired: Connect your pen to see and add books.

pen.disconnected: Please connect your pen with its USB cable

sync.hasNone: There are no PonyABC books on your pen yet.
sync.upToDate: All your books are up to date.
sync.stoppedNoSpace: Your pen filled up, so we stopped. The books that finished are on your pen.

space.title: Your pen doesn't have enough space
space.body: You need about {{amount}} more. Please back up your recordings and delete some you no longer need, then sync again.
space.unreadable: We couldn't check your pen's free space. Please unplug your pen, plug it in again and try again.

list.otherBody: These came from somewhere else. This app never changes them.
